description_en: Queries the error log details of an instance within a specified time range
description_zh: 查询实例指定时间范围内的错误日志明细
name: DescribeErrorLogRecords

parameters.help_en:
The node role. Valid values:

db
mongos

This parameter is supported only for ApsaraDB for MongoDB instances
parameters.help_zh:
节点角色：

db
mongos

仅云数据库MongoDB版实例支持
parameters.name: role

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. The value is in the format of a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

<notice>The value is of the Long type. Precision loss may occur during serialization/deserialization. The value must not be greater than 9007199254740991.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

<notice>该字段类型为Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于9007199254740991。></notice>
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. The value is in the format of a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.
<notice>The value is of the Long type. Precision loss may occur during serialization/deserialization. The value must not be greater than 9007199254740991.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。
<notice>该字段类型为Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于9007199254740991。></notice>
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en: The filter parameter. Set this parameter to filters
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The error log content to filter
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The filter conditions.

Filtering is supported only for error logs of ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL, ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL, PolarDB for MySQL, PolarDB for PostgreSQL, and PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Compatible with Oracle)
parameters.help_zh:
筛选条件。

仅支持RDS MySQL、RDS PostgreSQL、PolarDB MySQL版、PolarDB PostgreSQL版、PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）的错误日志筛选
parameters.name: filters
